palette_rationale: Identity colours live in the blue-violet-magenta arc (205-330 deg hue), which the status palette leaves empty: status uses brass/gold (thinking), teal (working), clay (waiting), red (error), sage (done) and warm grey (idle). Every identity colour is >= 25 CIEDE2000 from every status colour and >= 18 from every other agent (measured by gen/cast_check.py, see `checks`), and the set alternates value (indigo dark, ice light, cobalt mid, violet mid, mulberry dark, rose light; the three later leads take the remaining gaps at the extremes: lilac-white light, aubergine near-black, fuchsia mid-bright; with nine agents in this arc the best achievable minimum spacing is about 18) so pairs also separate by lightness for colour-blind viewers; silhouettes (hair/hat/outfit) differ for every agent, so colour is never the only cue. Accents are neutral trims (cream, silver, ink, walnut), each >= 20 CIEDE2000 from every status colour, so nothing tinted with an accent can read as a state. Use `color` for large masses (garments, desk accents), `text_on_dark` for names on any dark surface (nameplates, tooltips, HUD) and `text_on_light` for names on paper GUI and on lit monitor / console screens (warm e-ink paper); both are derived so that the worst case over every surface they are used on (listed in `checks`) is >= 4.5:1 (and text_on_dark >= 5.5:1 on plain ink); the measured worst case per agent is in `contrast`.

agents.name: Marlow
agents.title: Foreman & architect
agents.description: The calm, seasoned lead. Silver hair combed back from a side part, a trimmed light-silver beard and round walnut architect's spectacles, a yellow pencil tucked into his hair above the right ear. Long indigo chore coat (tails to mid-thigh) with walnut buttons and a brass lead badge, cream shirt and ink tie, graphite trousers, walnut brogues. Plans in shared memory, splits the goal, reviews everything before it reaches you.

agents.name: Juniper
agents.title: Researcher
agents.description: The library regular: reads the whole codebase before touching it. Big espresso-black coils falling past the nape, held back by a violet headband, small brass earrings, an open violet cardigan over a cream turtleneck, ink trousers with turned-up cuffs, clay-dark loafers. Curious, thorough, quotes the docs.

agents.name: Kit
agents.title: Builder & tester
agents.description: Lives at the test bench. Graphite rib-knit beanie with a cobalt stripe and cream pompom, cream over-ear headphones with brass sliders, ginger hair and freckles, a cobalt hoodie with the hood down and cream drawstrings, walnut cargo trousers, cream sneakers. Fast, cheerful, runs the tests twice.

agents.name: Wren
agents.title: Interface designer
agents.description: The polish pass. Ink-black blunt bob with heavy bangs and a rose beret, rosy cheeks, rose dungarees with brass buckles over a cream-and-ink breton tee, cuffed ankles, ink boots. Notices every misaligned pixel.

agents.name: Rowan
agents.title: Refactorer & reviewer
agents.description: The careful craftsman who untangles old code. Umber hair combed back into a round low bun in a mulberry scrunchie, full umber beard, a mulberry henley with sleeves rolled to the elbow, a tan leather workshop apron with brass rings and a pencil pocket, brass wristwatch, graphite trousers, walnut boots.

agents.name: Tove
agents.title: Archivist & QA
agents.description: Keeps the shared memory tidy and checks the work. Golden flax centre-parted hair in twin braids over the shoulders tied with ice-blue bands, deep-blue eyes and rosy cheeks, an ice-blue Nordic sweater with a cream snowflake yoke, graphite trousers, cream wool socks, walnut boots.

agents.name: Ines
agents.title: Lead · systems
agents.description: The systems lead: owns how the pieces of a building fit together. Brown skin, an ink-black undercut with one long fringe swept across the forehead, a small brass hoop. Pale-lilac cropped blazer with notch lapels, a flared peplum and a brass lead badge over an ink turtleneck, ink high-waisted wide-leg trousers pooling over cognac oxfords. Tall and narrow on top, wide at the ankle; a peer of Marlow who plans one building's architecture.

agents.name: Bram
agents.title: Lead · platform
agents.description: The platform lead: keeps a building's foundations, tooling and pipelines running. Tan skin, heavy brows and a thick walrus moustache under a tweed flat cap in deep aubergine with a brass button. Quilted aubergine work jacket with a walnut corduroy collar, brass zip, patch pockets and a brass lead badge over a cream henley, corduroy cuffs rolled at the wrist, khaki work trousers, black work boots with cream laces. Broad and square; a peer of Marlow who runs one building's infrastructure.

agents.name: Cass
agents.title: Lead · product
agents.description: The product lead: turns a building's goal into what actually ships. Light skin with freckles and rosy cheeks, auburn hair in a high ponytail with a fuchsia scrunchie (the tail hangs down the back), long side-swept bangs and a fuchsia clip. Cropped fuchsia bomber with a cream chest stripe, ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, brass zip and brass lead badge over a cream tee, ink high-waisted shorts with a brass buckle, cream knee socks with a fuchsia band, chunky ink boots. The only bare knees in the cast; a peer of Marlow who owns one building's scope.
